title: Very confused
review: Okay so I have the app Dogo but you have to pay for it. Like What That's Crazy!!!!!!!!! And it told me to download Wistle so I did. Bad decision. Wish I didn't. Not User Friendly. Click bottom and make noise. Noooo!!! It's not as simple as it makes it look. It's like quietest thing EVER!!!!!! Hard to work with. But I can hear so good thing I guess??? I'm still trying to figure it out.
author: Slay Girl01
devResponse: Please note that dogs detect sounds differently from humans. You can adjust the sound frequency that the whistle produces to fit your dog. For more details, please refer to the app description or consider messaging us at support@dogo.app.
